guide.bloodmagic.landing_text: Welcome to $(6)BLOODMAGIC$()! $(br2)There are still $(l:bloodmagic:utility/nyi)many contents$() that need to be improved. We also ask for your understanding of the inconvenience caused to you by frequent updates. $(br2)Click $(l:bloodmagic:utility/getting_started)here$() to start playing this module. If you find a vulnerability, please submit it to our $(l:https://github.com/WayofTime/BloodMagic/issues)Github$() page.

ritual.bloodmagic.altarBuilderRitual.inf: Build the altar pieces from the attached container.
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.che: (Box) A box used to store items for feeding animals.
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.def: (Native) Increase the running speed of the ritual based on the total amount of will in the spiritual realm.
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.des: (Destruction) Make adult animals that have not recently produced offspring rush towards monsters and explode themselves
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.gro: (Growth) Animals in this area will grow faster.
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.inf: Increases the growth rate of young animals within its range.
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.ste: (Fortitude) Use items in boxes to feed animals in the area
ritual.bloodmagic.animalGrowthRitual.ven: (Revenge) Reduce the time between breeding of adult animals
ritual.bloodmagic.armourEvolveRitual.inf: Increase the upgrade points of your Soulbinder armor to 300 points.
ritual.bloodmagic.blockRange.firstBlock: Record the first block of the new range.
ritual.bloodmagic.blockRange.inactive: This ritual stone is currently inactive and has no scope for modification.
ritual.bloodmagic.blockRange.tooBig: The range offered is too large! Maximum of %s blocks.
ritual.bloodmagic.blockRange.tooFar: The range provided is too far! Need to be within %s vertical blocks and horizontal %s blocks.
ritual.bloodmagic.condorRitual.flightRan: Players within this range will gain flying effects.
ritual.bloodmagic.condorRitual.info: The ritual provides the ability to fly within a certain range nearby.
ritual.bloodmagic.containmentRitual.cont: (Pull) An area where a ritual draws a creature. Regardless of where the area is located, all creatures are drawn toward the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.containmentRitual.info: Draws all creatures within its range toward the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.chest.i: (chest) The location of the chest into which the ritual will place the destroyed blocks.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.corrosi: (Corrosion) All destroyed blocks will be treated with base cutting oil. Cover accurate collection where applicable.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.crushin: (Dig) Blocks in this area will be destroyed.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.default: (Native) Increase the running speed of the ritual based on the total amount of will in the spiritual realm.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.destruc: (Destruction) Powerful block breaking: All block destruction is affected by Luck III.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.info: Destroys blocks within its mining range and places the dropped items in the connected chest.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.steadfa: (Perseverance) Use Accurate Collection to obtain destroyed blocks. Fortune coverage is available where applicable.
ritual.bloodmagic.crushingRitual.vengefu: (Revengeance) Compressing items in the inventory (such as compressing coal into coal blocks) currently only performs compression once per operation.
ritual.bloodmagic.crystalHarvestRitual.c: (Crystal) clusters will be destroyed into clusters of single crystals, and the destroyed crystals will fall into the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.crystalHarvestRitual.i: Destroy the Devil's Will crystal cluster within the range, and the dropped items will be thrown on top of the crystal cluster.
ritual.bloodmagic.crystalSplitRitual.inf: Split the original population of well-grown crystals into independent populations of desired crystals.
ritual.bloodmagic.downgradeRitual.info: Consumes the contents of a connected chest, effectively adding a downgrade to the bundle armor and reducing the points already spent
ritual.bloodmagic.ellipseRitual.chest.in: (Box) The location of the box, and the ritual will extract the blocks from it and place them in the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.ellipseRitual.info: Use attached boxes to create a hollow sphere around the ceremony.
ritual.bloodmagic.ellipseRitual.spheroid: (Place) The range within which the ritual will be placed. The sphere is centered around the ritual - if one side is shorter than the side opposite the sphere, it is truncated.
ritual.bloodmagic.eternalSoulRitual.info: Transferring the Essence of Life from a soul network to an altar at a loss.
ritual.bloodmagic.expulsionRitual.expuls: (Expulsion) Players who are not the owner of the ritual in this area, or players who have orbs in the box, will be teleported away from this place.
ritual.bloodmagic.expulsionRitual.info: Banish players within range who are not activators or have no bound blood orbs in the chest above the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.featheredKnifeRitual.a: (Altar) The area of the altar that stipulates ritual detection of blood. This item is modified to add or cancel a coordinate.
ritual.bloodmagic.featheredKnifeRitual.d: (Damage) Specifies the area where the ritual damages the player. Players in this area will continue to take damage until the set minimum health limit.
(Native) Increase the running speed of the ritual based on the total amount of will in the spiritual realm.
(Destruction) Increase the LP output of the ritual according to the total amount of will
ritual.bloodmagic.featheredKnifeRitual.i: Deduct the health of players within its range and store the LP gained into the nearby Blood Altar.
ritual.bloodmagic.featheredKnifeRitual.s: (Fortitude) Set the minimum health sacrificed to 30%% to 70%%.
ritual.bloodmagic.featheredKnifeRitual.v: Set minimum health sacrificed to 10%%. The effect of coverage (Fortitude)
ritual.bloodmagic.fellingRitual.chest.in: (chest) The chest location into which the ritual will place the drops.
ritual.bloodmagic.fellingRitual.fellingR: (Heaving) The area where logs and leaves will be searched for and felled during the ceremony.
ritual.bloodmagic.fellingRitual.info: A logging facility, this ritual will cut down all trees and leaves within its range and collect the drops.
ritual.bloodmagic.forsakenSoulRitual.che: (Chest) Chest location from which the ritual will extract the Catalyst item.
ritual.bloodmagic.forsakenSoulRitual.cry: (Crystal) When a creature dies due to the ritual, the crystal clusters in the area will grow faster.
ritual.bloodmagic.forsakenSoulRitual.dam: (Damage) Creatures in the area will slowly take damage, and crystal clusters will grow when they die.
ritual.bloodmagic.forsakenSoulRitual.inf: Causes damage to creatures within its damage range, and when the creature dies, demonic clusters within its crystal range will grow.
ritual.bloodmagic.fullStomachRitual.ches: (Box) The location of the box, the ritual will extract the food in it to feed players in the area.
ritual.bloodmagic.fullStomachRitual.fill: The (Feeding) ritual will feed players in the area.
ritual.bloodmagic.fullStomachRitual.info: Get food from connected chests to replenish the player's hunger bar.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.corro: (Corrosion) Entities within range will be attacked by nearby plants, eating away at their health.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.defau: (Native) Speed ​​up all ritual operations based on the total amount of will in the spiritual realm.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.destr: (Destruction) The range of accelerated crop growth increases according to the total amount of will.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.growi: (Growth) An area where rituals speed up plant growth.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.hydra: (Fortitude) Blocks in the area will be moistened into farmland, and seeds in the area will be planted nearby.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.info: Crops are grown within its boundaries.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.leech: (Corruption) The life of entities in the area will be lost to nourishing nearby crops.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.stead: (Fortitude) Within the hydration range, seeds will be replanted and blocks will be moistened.
ritual.bloodmagic.greenGroveRitual.venge: (Revenge) Increases the rate of growth tick success.
ritual.bloodmagic.groundingRitual.destru: (Destruction) acts on the heart (increases fall damage) + (Revenge) enhances the effect.
ritual.bloodmagic.groundingRitual.ground: (Scope) Entities within the scope of influence.
ritual.bloodmagic.groundingRitual.info: Press the entity to the ground to prevent it from jumping.
ritual.bloodmagic.groundingRitual.steadf: (Perseverance) affects the Boss. It does not affect bosses that are immune to negative potion effects or negative effects that affect movement (except withers and ender dragons).
ritual.bloodmagic.groundingRitual.vengef: (Revenge) enhances the effect. +(Corruption) Enables Ascension Mode. + (Destruction) affects the heart more.
ritual.bloodmagic.harvestRitual.harvestR: (Harvest) Plants in this area will be harvested.
ritual.bloodmagic.harvestRitual.info: Harvest plants within its range, and the products drop to the ground.
ritual.bloodmagic.interdictionRitual.inf: Pushes all creatures within its range away from the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.interdictionRitual.int: (Push Away) A ritual that pushes away a creature's area. Regardless of where the area is located, all creatures will be pushed away from the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.jumpRitual.info: Causes the entity to leap high into the air.
ritual.bloodmagic.jumpRitual.jumpPower.i: (Power) describes the total height that controls jump height and consumption.
ritual.bloodmagic.jumpRitual.jumpRange.i: (Jump) Entities within this area will jump high into the air.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.corrosive.i: (Corrosion) Entities within range that are immune to fire damage will take damage.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.default.inf: (Native) Reduces the LP cost of generating lava and directs lava into connected containers.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.destructive: (Destruction) The placement range of lava increases according to the total amount of Will.
(Corrosion) Entities immune to fire damage in this area will be damaged, and the amount of damage is related to the amount of Will.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.fireFuse.in: (Revenge) Entities within this area will suffer from the Fire Fuse effect.
(Fortitude) Grants fire protection to players within range.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.info: Generate a lava source block from the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.lavaRange.i: (Lava) The area where lava blocks are placed in rituals.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.lavaTank.in: (Native) Ritual will channel lava into its own fluid tank.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.steadfast.i: (Fortitude) Grants fire protection to players within range.
ritual.bloodmagic.lavaRitual.vengeful.in: (Revenge) gives the fire fuse effect to entities within the range.
ritual.bloodmagic.magneticRitual.info: Teleports ore from the ground to the area where it is placed.
ritual.bloodmagic.magneticRitual.placeme: The (Placement) ritual will place the obtained ore in this area.
ritual.bloodmagic.meteorRitual.info: Consumes an item within its item range to summon a resource-filled meteor from the sky that plummets directly towards the ritual.
ritual.bloodmagic.placerRitual.chest.inf: (Box) The location of the box, and the ritual will extract the blocks from it and place them in the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.placerRitual.info: Remove the block from the connected container and place it in the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.placerRitual.placerRan: (Placement) The area where the ritual will place the block.
ritual.bloodmagic.portalRitual.info: Create a portal network based on the activator and the direct contact block. Two portals that are the same are connected. Blocks can be changed if the teleport network is not modified after activation.
ritual.bloodmagic.pumpRitual.info: Obtain liquid from specified range. Only move in liquid if the connected liquid container contains at least one bucket of the same liquid.
ritual.bloodmagic.pumpRitual.pumpRange.i: (Water Diversion) Ritual to obtain liquid from an area of ​​the world.
ritual.bloodmagic.regenerationRitual.cor: (Corruption) Drains blood from non-player entities to heal players
ritual.bloodmagic.regenerationRitual.hea: (Healing) Entities within the area will gain health regeneration.
ritual.bloodmagic.regenerationRitual.inf: Heals entities within range that have lost health.
ritual.bloodmagic.regenerationRitual.vam: (Blood Leech) drains the life of monsters in the area to heal players.
ritual.bloodmagic.simpleDungeonRitual: The Fate of the Hidden Realm
ritual.bloodmagic.simpleDungeonRitual.in: Generates an inversion pillar, a fragile portal to the demonic realm
(Corrosion) Further increases movement speed based on total willpower.
ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.default.in: (Native) Increases the movement speed generated by the ritual based on the total amount of will.
ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.destructiv: (Destruction) prevents players and baby animals from being transported, and if paired with (Revenge), transports players.
ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.info: Launches players within range in the direction of the ritual.
ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.sanicRange: (Speed) All entities located in this area will be ejected in the direction of the arrows formed by the ritual pendulum.
(Fortitude) Apply light fall to creatures and players when being teleported, preventing falling damage.
ritual.bloodmagic.speedRitual.vengeful.i: (Revenge) prevents players from being transported with adult animals, and transports players if paired with (Destruction)
ritual.bloodmagic.sphereRitual.info: Gaps tear open the ground, transporting the sphere from the ground into the air. The extracted shape will be a sphere of the specified size.
ritual.bloodmagic.sphereRitual.spheroidR: (Extraction) The range from which the ritual will extract blocks. These squares are placed vertically opposite the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.suppressionRitual.info: Suppresses liquids within its range; restored when ritual is deactivated.
ritual.bloodmagic.suppressionRitual.supp: (Suppression) All liquids in the area will be ritually suppressed.
ritual.bloodmagic.upgradeRemoveRitual.in: Removes all upgrades (and downgrades) from the Soul Armor and gives you the corresponding upgrade (downgrade) manual. These manuals can also be applied again to your beam armor.
ritual.bloodmagic.waterRitual.info: Generate a water source block from the main ritual stone.
ritual.bloodmagic.waterRitual.waterRange: (Water source) The area where the water source block is placed in the ritual.
(Native) A tank into which water is directed for ritual purposes.
(Altar) The area of the altar that stipulates ritual detection of blood. This item is modified to add or cancel a coordinate.
(Damage) Specifies the area in which the ritual harms creatures. All creatures in the area (except the player) will continue to take damage.
Attacks creatures within its damage range and stores the LP gained into the nearby Blood Altar.

ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.corr: (Corruption) Destroy blocks that match the filter. The rest will not be destroyed.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.defa: (Native) Increase the running speed of the ritual based on the total amount of will in the spiritual realm.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.info: Destroy blocks in a large area.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.plac: (Placement) Undestroyed blocks are placed within range according to will configuration.
ritual.bloodmagic.yawningVoidRitual.stea: (Fortitude) Blocks that have not been destroyed are placed in a separate area. If no filter is applied, all blocks are moved.
ritual.bloodmagic.zephyrRitual.chest.inf: (chest) The chest location into which the ritual will place the picked items.
ritual.bloodmagic.zephyrRitual.info: Pick up dropped items within its range and place them into the connected chest.
ritual.bloodmagic.zephyrRitual.zephyrRan: (Pickup) Items in this area will be picked up and stored in the connected box.

ritual.bloodmagic.craftingRitual.inputRa: (Crate)Input: Items used for crafting are taken from this inventory.
